data.name: MFH2_001
data.value: He's been hard to handle lately...[pause=0] I don't know what to do with him...

data.name: MFH3_001
data.value: Sniff...[pause=0] My baby boy...[pause=0] He's growing up so fast...

data.name: MFH4_001
data.value: You've earned one with all your hard work,[pause=10] you just have to wait a little while more!

data.name: MFH5_001
data.value: I've been rewarding him with Lava Cakes when he finishes all of his chores for the day, but...

data.name: MFH5_002
data.value: I may need to cut down on how many I give him.[pause=0] I don't want him to start getting chubby!

data.name: MFH6_001
data.value: You're back from the mountain![pause=0] I could hear the whole guild cheering from here.

data.name: MFH6_002
data.value: {0} hasn't stopped talking about it.[pause=0] He wants to climb a mountain too, now.

data.name: MFH6_003
data.value: Three famous explorers in town...[pause=10] and here I am scrubbing a soot-covered stove.

data.name: MFH6_004
data.value: {0} asked if they'd come say hello.[pause=0] I told him fame doesn't pay house visits.

data.name: MFH6_005
data.value: You're going into the forest for that poor little bug?[pause=10] Be careful in there.

data.name: MFH6_006
data.value: {0} keeps asking when you'll be back.[pause=0] I keep telling him "soon". I hope I'm right.

data.name: MFH6_007
data.value: You brought that little one home safe![pause=0] {0} hasn't stopped grinning since he heard.

data.name: MFH6_008
data.value: He says he wants to help someone someday, the way you helped him.[pause=0] Small steps, I suppose.
